comment: Pinned prebuilt native runtime. One revision, one ABI, one archive per target. Written by scripts/native-runtime/publish-runtime.mjs --write-pin; read by fetch-runtime.mjs, which refuses bytes whose sha256/size differ and refuses the whole pin when `abi` is not the ABI this checkout requires (scripts/native-runtime/abi.mjs). A target with `archive: null` has no published artifact and falls back to the developer source build.
